mapping_contract.entrypoint: ordinary Rust map_resolved_npm_inputs; never a Substreams handler
mapping_contract.source: one complete validated uniswap.npm.source.v1.NpmSourceBlock embedded byte-for-byte
mapping_contract.call_scope: exact EIP-1898 hash equal to source.block.hash or explicit number fallback equal to source.block.number
mapping_contract.position_results: resolved Position value or resolved None
mapping_contract.pool_results: resolved 20-byte value including zero or resolved None
mapping_contract.resolution_gate: transient payload-free Resolved, PossibleReorg, or Unknown status; only Resolved reaches protobuf
mapping_contract.unstable_resolution: PossibleReorg or Unknown aborts before frame construction and before any reducer/checkpoint decision
mapping_contract.all_supplied_rows: normalized and structurally validated before the joint reducer is invoked, including the would-be post-fatal suffix

replay_contract.entrypoint: reduce_npm_resolved_input_frame delegates one validated frame to the exact joint reducer
replay_contract.source_transactions: exact NpmSourceBlock TransactionRef rows become reducer TransactionMetadata
replay_contract.pool_zero: ReducerInputs returns the exact zero address
replay_contract.pool_none: ReducerInputs returns a deterministic handler error
replay_contract.authority: source frame, input frame, normal projection, and fatal projection each authorize neither Graph block nor checkpoint success

determinism_contract.positions: position manager then fixed-width token id
determinism_contract.protobuf: canonical prost encoding; unknown and noncanonical outer or nested source bytes rejected
